meta.title: Korea trip: Seoul + Busan, 13–22 Dec 2026
caveats: Hotels are provisional (not booked). Scrapbook directions start/end at voco Seoul Myeongdong (Hoehyeon Stn Exit 3) and Busan Business Hotel (Seomyeon Stn Exit 7). If James picks a Hongdae hotel (Amanti or 9 Brick), all Seoul hotel-based directions (Days 1–7) change.
Day 1 and Day 10 timelines assume flight Option A (Korean Air/Asiana). Option B (Jeju Air) lands 08:40 on Day 1 and its 22 Dec return time is not checked.
Prices are estimates researched 25 Oct 2026 (Day 4/5 changes researched 27 Oct 2026) unless marked as quoted; fares can change until booked.
Day 4 has two versions: Plan A (Gangchon Rail Park rail bike + Dongdaemun night) and Plan B (Everland). Pick one; both need booking ahead.

Booking status legend: Not booked = must be booked but isn't yet (hotels/flights); Needs booking = reservation/ticket to be bought in advance; No booking needed = walk-in/pay on the spot; TBD = not decided or not checked. Statuses for walk-in items are inferred from the pages (free sights, markets, pay-at-counter).

days.area: Airport → Seoul Station → our hotel (Myeongdong edge)
days.title: Hello Seoul! Land, train, sleep
days.planning_summary: Arrival day: depends on flight. Option A, Korean Air/Asiana (land 18:10, Terminal 2): AREX Express to Seoul Station (₩13,000 (S$12.54), 51 min; departures include 19:15 and 20:05), hotel about 20:30–21:00, late dinner nearby. Option B, Jeju Air red-eye (land 08:40): AREX into town, drop bags at the hotel (check-in is usually later), brunch, then an easy Myeongdong afternoon: shops, LINE Friends Square (43 Myeongdong-gil, 11:00–22:00), DDP. Nap, then the lanterns at Cheonggyecheon, with Wangbijib galbi for dinner (last order 21:00). Either way, get T-money/WOWPASS at the airport.

days.planning_summary: Updated 27 Oct 2026 (replaces Nami Island). Plan A: Gyeongchun Line from Cheongnyangni to Gimyujeong (~86 min, ₩3,050 (S$2.94), T-money), dakgalbi lunch, Gangchon Rail Park rail bike 13:30 (₩40,000 (S$38.57) per 2-seat bike; book ahead), back to Seoul, Dongdaemun shopping (Hyundai City Outlet, Doota), dinner at Doota food court, optional Sparex jjimjilbang. Plan B: Everland day (see Plan B below).

other_ways_to_get_there: Red bus 4105 from Seoul Station Bus Transfer Center (platform 5) to Everland: ₩3,200 (S$3.09) each way by T-money, about 1 hour; weekday gaps can be long, so check Naver Map.
Subway: Suin-Bundang Line to Giheung, then the EverLine to Jeondae·Everland (just under 30 min), then Everland's free shuttle bus to the park.
notes: Pokémon Forest: I could not find one at Everland. The friend's 'Pokémon Forest' matches PokéPark KANTO's Pokémon Forest in Tokyo (opened 5 Feb 2026) or the Pokémon Secret Forest event at Seoul Forest (1 May–21 Jun 2026, now over). Not available on 16 Dec.
Everland's 2026 winter festival had not been announced on 26 Oct 2026; last year's Christmas Fantasy ran 28 Nov–31 Dec 2025.
Rides can stop in heavy rain, strong wind or very low temperatures.
